releases.notes:
## Version 1.2.2
- Hotfix: Fixed an issue where message IDs could cause an integer overflow

# Version 1.2.1
- Added the option to have multiple ressources for each spell (up to 3)

## Version 1.2.0

- (optional) seasonal decorations to give your spellbook a little more flair
- You can now move and anchor your buffs and debuffs wherever you want
- The settings menu was very cluttered, so there are now submenus to make it easier to find your way around
- You can now adjust some text and all spellbook buttons a little with sliders
- You can now choose Spellbook's language independently of your client language
- When you share your spells/abilities, their preset fields are now translated automatically
- You can now flip through your spellbook with the mouse wheel
- Spell/ability icons are now displayed correctly when hovering over chat links
- Future versions will now have changelogs you can read in game. You can view the current one at any time by clicking the version in the settings
- Prat 3.0 is now supported, as there were some issues with it
- There was a scrollbar bug with long spell/ability descriptions. It's now fixed

# Version 1.1

- Added Magic for dracthyr
  - prismatic magic type
  - alle colored essences as a ressource
- added customizable dropdown menu points (you can now type your own dropdown menu point if you wish)
- fixed a visual bug, where you had two cursors while editing a spell
- changed the default book icon
